dataset: WesternCondition canon shortlist (E2 skeleton WITH bidirectional mappings, per CONDITIONS_MODULE_DESIGN)
policy: Skeleton + mapping layer written by Claude (the knowledge-dense part). Every related_eastern_diseases id exists in tdis_registry.json; every related_patterns id exists in pattern_library.json. Prose fields (summary, red_flags, western_context, seeds) are E3 fill batches — a condition may NOT render until red_flags is filled. All draft / needs_source_review. Mappings are study references, not diagnostic equivalence claims.

records.summary_zh: 多囊性卵巢症候群是育齡女性常見的內分泌與代謝失調，特徵為排卵稀少或不排卵、雄性素過高表現（如多毛、痤瘡）與超音波多囊卵巢型態，常伴月經稀發及不孕。診斷多採 Rotterdam 標準（三取二），並需排除其他高雄性素病因。
records.summary_en: PCOS is a common reproductive-age endocrine and metabolic disorder marked by oligo-/anovulation, clinical or biochemical hyperandrogenism, and polycystic ovarian morphology, often with irregular cycles and subfertility. Diagnosis commonly uses the Rotterdam criteria (2 of 3) after excluding other causes of hyperandrogenism.
red_flags_zh: 異常大量或持續子宮出血需評估子宮內膜病變
長期無月經合併子宮內膜增厚，需排除內膜增生／癌變
突發嚴重骨盆腔痛需排除卵巢扭轉或其他急症
疑似懷孕
急劇雄性素上升或男性化需排除分泌雄性素之腫瘤
red_flags_en: Abnormally heavy or prolonged uterine bleeding — evaluate the endometrium
Prolonged amenorrhea with thickened endometrium — rule out hyperplasia/carcinoma
Sudden severe pelvic pain — rule out ovarian torsion or other acute cause
Possible pregnancy
Rapid virilization or steeply rising androgens — rule out an androgen-secreting tumor
records.western_context_zh: 【多囊性卵巢症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：E28.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with lifestyle modification, weight management, and — depending on fertility goals — agents such as ovulation induction, combined oral contraceptives for cycle regulation, or insulin sensitizers. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 子宮內膜異位症指子宮內膜組織生長於子宮腔外（常見於卵巢、腹膜、子宮薦韌帶），造成慢性骨盆腔痛、經痛、性交痛與不孕；確診多需腹腔鏡與病理，影像可輔助評估卵巢子宮內膜異位瘤。
records.summary_en: Endometriosis is the presence of endometrial-like tissue outside the uterine cavity (commonly ovary, peritoneum, uterosacral ligaments), causing chronic pelvic pain, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, and infertility. Definitive diagnosis usually needs laparoscopy with histology; imaging helps assess endometriomas.
red_flags_zh: 急性劇烈骨盆腔痛需排除卵巢子宮內膜異位瘤破裂或扭轉
腸道或膀胱周期性出血提示深部浸潤，需專科評估
疑似懷孕合併劇痛需排除異位妊娠
不孕需生殖專科評估
red_flags_en: Acute severe pelvic pain — rule out ruptured or torsed endometrioma
Cyclical bowel or bladder bleeding suggests deep infiltrating disease — refer for specialist assessment
Possible pregnancy with severe pain — rule out ectopic pregnancy
Infertility — refer for reproductive evaluation
records.western_context_zh: 【子宮內膜異位症】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N80）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with analgesia, hormonal suppression (e.g., combined contraceptives, progestins, GnRH analogues), or surgery, tailored to pain and fertility goals. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 子宮肌瘤為子宮平滑肌之良性腫瘤，常見於育齡女性，可無症狀或引起經量過多、骨盆腔壓迫、頻尿與不孕，症狀與肌瘤大小及位置（黏膜下、肌壁間、漿膜下）相關。
records.summary_en: Uterine fibroids are benign smooth-muscle tumors of the uterus, common in reproductive-age women. They may be asymptomatic or cause heavy menstrual bleeding, pelvic pressure, urinary frequency, and infertility, depending on size and location (submucosal, intramural, subserosal).
red_flags_zh: 嚴重或持續出血導致貧血症狀（頭暈、心悸、氣短）需即時評估
急性劇痛提示肌瘤變性或帶蒂肌瘤扭轉
快速長大或停經後仍長大需排除惡性（子宮肉瘤）
壓迫症狀導致排尿或排便困難
red_flags_en: Severe or ongoing bleeding with anemia symptoms (dizziness, palpitations, dyspnea) — evaluate promptly
Acute severe pain suggests fibroid degeneration or torsion of a pedunculated fibroid
Rapid growth or growth after menopause — rule out malignancy (uterine sarcoma)
Mass effect causing urinary or bowel obstruction
records.western_context_zh: 【子宮肌瘤】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：D25）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Depending on symptoms and fertility goals, management ranges from observation and medical control of bleeding to myomectomy or hysterectomy. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 原發性痛經指無骨盆腔器質病變的經期疼痛，多因前列腺素引起子宮過度收縮，常於初經後 1–2 年開始，疼痛集中於下腹並可放射至腰背與大腿。
records.summary_en: Primary dysmenorrhea is menstrual pain without pelvic pathology, largely from prostaglandin-mediated uterine hypercontractility. It typically begins within 1–2 years of menarche, with cramping lower-abdominal pain that may radiate to the back and thighs.
red_flags_zh: 疼痛型態改變或成年後才新發之痛經應排除次發性病因（如內膜異位）
發燒、異常分泌物提示骨盆腔感染
疑似懷孕合併劇痛需排除異位妊娠
止痛無效且進行性加重需進一步影像評估
red_flags_en: Change in pain pattern or new-onset dysmenorrhea in adulthood — rule out secondary causes (e.g., endometriosis)
Fever or abnormal discharge suggests pelvic infection
Possible pregnancy with severe pain — rule out ectopic pregnancy
Pain unresponsive to analgesia and progressively worsening — pursue imaging
records.western_context_zh: 【原發性痛經】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N94.4）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with NSAIDs, combined oral contraceptives, and local heat. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 經前症候群指黃體期反覆出現、月經來潮後緩解的身心症狀（如乳房脹痛、腹脹、易怒、情緒低落、疲倦），症狀須與月經週期有明確時間關聯並影響生活功能。
records.summary_en: Premenstrual syndrome is a cyclical cluster of physical and mood symptoms (breast tenderness, bloating, irritability, low mood, fatigue) in the luteal phase that resolve after menses, with a clear temporal link to the cycle and functional impact.
red_flags_zh: 嚴重情緒低落、絕望或自殺意念需即時心理／精神科評估
症狀無週期性或持續整月，應重新評估診斷
症狀急遽惡化影響安全或工作能力
red_flags_en: Severe low mood, hopelessness, or suicidal ideation — urgent mental-health evaluation
Non-cyclical or month-long symptoms — reconsider the diagnosis
Rapid worsening affecting safety or function
records.western_context_zh: 【經前症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N94.3）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with lifestyle and dietary measures, exercise, and where needed serotonergic agents or hormonal approaches. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 月經不調為描述性名詞，涵蓋週期、經期長短或經量的異常，成因多元（內分泌、結構、藥物、體重與壓力等），需依型態進一步鑑別。
records.summary_en: Irregular menstruation is a descriptive term covering abnormalities of cycle length, duration, or flow, with many causes (endocrine, structural, medication, weight, stress). It requires further characterization to guide differential diagnosis.
red_flags_zh: 任何停經後出血需評估子宮內膜
大量出血合併貧血症狀需即時處理
疑似懷孕
合併泌乳、視野缺損或頭痛需排除腦下垂體病變
red_flags_en: Any postmenopausal bleeding — evaluate the endometrium
Heavy bleeding with anemia symptoms — treat promptly
Possible pregnancy
Galactorrhea, visual-field loss, or headache — rule out pituitary pathology
records.western_context_zh: 【月經不調】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N92.6）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management depends on the underlying cause and may include hormonal regulation and correction of endocrine or structural contributors. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 月經過多指經量顯著增加或經期延長，可能造成缺鐵性貧血；成因包括排卵功能障礙、子宮肌瘤或內膜息肉、凝血異常及內膜病變等。
records.summary_en: Heavy menstrual bleeding is markedly increased flow or prolonged menses that may cause iron-deficiency anemia. Causes include ovulatory dysfunction, fibroids or polyps, coagulopathy, and endometrial pathology.
red_flags_zh: 急性大量出血合併血壓下降、心悸、暈厥屬急症，需立即就醫
停經後出血或不規則出血需排除內膜增生／癌變
易瘀青或家族出血病史提示凝血疾病
貧血症狀明顯（極度疲倦、氣短）
red_flags_en: Acute heavy bleeding with hypotension, palpitations, or syncope is an emergency — seek immediate care
Postmenopausal or irregular bleeding — rule out endometrial hyperplasia/carcinoma
Easy bruising or family bleeding history suggests coagulopathy
Marked anemia symptoms (severe fatigue, dyspnea)
records.western_context_zh: 【月經過多】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N92.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with iron repletion, hormonal or non-hormonal agents to reduce bleeding, and treatment of structural causes. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 月經過少指經量明顯減少或經期縮短，成因包括內分泌失衡（如多囊、甲狀腺、高泌乳素）、子宮內膜損傷（如宮腔沾黏）、體重過低或壓力等。
records.summary_en: Scanty or infrequent menstruation refers to reduced flow or shortened menses. Causes include endocrine imbalance (PCOS, thyroid, hyperprolactinemia), endometrial damage (intrauterine adhesions), low body weight, and stress.
red_flags_zh: 合併泌乳、頭痛或視野缺損需排除腦下垂體病變
近期子宮腔手術後經量驟減提示宮腔沾黏
疑似懷孕
顯著體重下降或過度運動導致停經傾向
red_flags_en: Galactorrhea, headache, or visual-field loss — rule out pituitary pathology
Sharp drop in flow after recent uterine surgery suggests intrauterine adhesions
Possible pregnancy
Marked weight loss or over-exercise trending toward amenorrhea
records.western_context_zh: 【月經過少】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N91.5）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management focuses on correcting the underlying endocrine or structural cause and addressing fertility goals. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 繼發性閉經指曾有月經者停經達三個週期或六個月以上，最常見原因為懷孕，其他包括下視丘功能性抑制、多囊、高泌乳素、甲狀腺異常、卵巢功能不全及宮腔沾黏等。
records.summary_en: Secondary amenorrhea is the absence of menses for three cycles or six months in someone who previously menstruated. Pregnancy is the most common cause; others include functional hypothalamic suppression, PCOS, hyperprolactinemia, thyroid disease, ovarian insufficiency, and intrauterine adhesions.
red_flags_zh: 首先排除懷孕
合併泌乳、頭痛或視野缺損需排除腦下垂體腫瘤
潮熱、盜汗與 40 歲前停經提示卵巢早衰，需評估
顯著體重過低或飲食失調需整體醫療評估
red_flags_en: Rule out pregnancy first
Galactorrhea, headache, or visual-field loss — rule out a pituitary tumor
Hot flashes, night sweats, and cessation before 40 suggest premature ovarian insufficiency — evaluate
Marked underweight or an eating disorder warrants broad medical evaluation
records.western_context_zh: 【繼發性閉經】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N91.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management is cause-specific and may include correcting prolactin or thyroid abnormalities, hormonal support, and nutritional/weight restoration. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 女性不孕症一般指規律無避孕性行為一年（35 歲以上為半年）仍未受孕。成因包括排卵障礙、輸卵管與骨盆因素、子宮與內膜因素及卵巢儲備下降等，需伴侶雙方評估。
records.summary_en: Female infertility is generally defined as failure to conceive after one year of regular unprotected intercourse (six months if age ≥35). Causes include ovulatory disorders, tubal/pelvic factors, uterine/endometrial factors, and diminished ovarian reserve; both partners should be evaluated.
red_flags_zh: 劇烈骨盆腔痛或異常出血需先排除急症與異位妊娠
35 歲以上或有卵巢儲備疑慮者宜及早轉介生殖專科
已知輸卵管病變、重度內膜異位或無精症需專科處理
反覆流產史需另作評估
red_flags_en: Severe pelvic pain or abnormal bleeding — rule out acute causes and ectopic pregnancy first
Age ≥35 or ovarian-reserve concerns — refer to reproductive medicine early
Known tubal disease, severe endometriosis, or azoospermia needs specialist care
History of recurrent pregnancy loss warrants separate evaluation
records.western_context_zh: 【女性不孕症】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N97）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Evaluation and management commonly include ovulation tracking, tubal and semen assessment, and — by cause — ovulation induction or assisted reproductive technology. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 男性不育症指男方因素導致的生育困難，常見於精液品質異常（少精、弱精、畸形精子或無精），成因包括精索靜脈曲張、內分泌、感染、遺傳與生活型態等，需精液分析評估。
records.summary_en: Male factor infertility refers to subfertility from male causes, often abnormal semen parameters (oligo-, astheno-, teratozoospermia, or azoospermia). Causes include varicocele, endocrine, infectious, genetic, and lifestyle factors; semen analysis is central to evaluation.
red_flags_zh: 無精症或嚴重異常需泌尿／生殖專科與遺傳評估
睪丸腫塊或不對稱需排除睪丸腫瘤
性功能障礙合併荷爾蒙症狀需內分泌評估
泌尿感染或疼痛徵象
red_flags_en: Azoospermia or severe abnormalities — refer to urology/reproductive medicine and genetic evaluation
Testicular mass or asymmetry — rule out testicular tumor
Sexual dysfunction with hormonal symptoms — endocrine evaluation
Signs of urinary infection or pain
records.western_context_zh: 【男性不育症】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N46）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management is cause-specific and may include varicocele correction, hormonal treatment, lifestyle change, or assisted reproduction. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 卵巢儲備功能下降指卵子數量與品質較同齡下降，可由抗穆勒氏管荷爾蒙（AMH）、竇卵泡數與 FSH 等評估，與受孕率下降及對排卵刺激反應不良相關。
records.summary_en: Diminished ovarian reserve is a reduction in oocyte quantity and quality relative to age, assessed by AMH, antral follicle count, and FSH. It is associated with lower conception rates and poorer response to ovarian stimulation.
red_flags_zh: 40 歲前出現卵巢功能不全徵象（潮熱、停經）需評估卵巢早衰
計畫生育者宜及早轉介生殖專科討論時效性
合併停經症狀影響生活品質
red_flags_en: Signs of ovarian insufficiency before 40 (hot flashes, amenorrhea) — evaluate for premature ovarian insufficiency
If pregnancy is desired, refer to reproductive medicine early given time-sensitivity
Menopausal symptoms affecting quality of life
records.western_context_zh: 【卵巢儲備功能下降】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：E28.3）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly discussed within reproductive care regarding stimulation-protocol adjustment, fertility timing, and available options. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 試管嬰兒療程輔助（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 此為試管嬰兒／輔助生殖療程期間的輔助照護文件情境，涵蓋刺激期、取卵、植入與黃體支持等階段之症狀紀錄與整體性支持，非獨立西醫診斷。
records.summary_en: This is a documentation context for adjunctive care during IVF/ART cycles, spanning stimulation, retrieval, transfer, and luteal support phases for symptom tracking and whole-person support. It is not a standalone Western diagnosis.
red_flags_zh: 刺激期後腹脹、少尿、體重驟增或呼吸困難提示卵巢過度刺激症候群（OHSS），屬急症
取卵後劇烈腹痛或發燒需排除出血或感染
植入後劇痛合併陰道出血需排除併發症
任何疑似異位妊娠徵象
red_flags_en: Post-stimulation bloating, reduced urine output, rapid weight gain, or dyspnea suggests ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) — an emergency
Severe abdominal pain or fever after retrieval — rule out bleeding or infection
Severe pain with vaginal bleeding after transfer — rule out complications
Any signs suggesting ectopic pregnancy
records.western_context_zh: 【試管嬰兒療程輔助（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：Z31.83）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Adjunctive care proceeds under the reproductive team's cycle plan; documentation does not replace reproductive medical management. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 習慣性流產（文件情境）一般指連續兩次以上的自然流產，成因包括染色體、子宮結構、內分泌（如甲狀腺、血糖）、抗磷脂症候群與凝血異常等，需系統性評估雙方。
records.summary_en: Recurrent pregnancy loss (context) generally refers to two or more consecutive spontaneous miscarriages. Causes include chromosomal, uterine structural, endocrine (thyroid, glucose), antiphospholipid syndrome, and thrombophilia; systematic evaluation of both partners is warranted.
red_flags_zh: 急性大量出血或劇痛合併頭暈屬急症，需立即就醫
疑似異位妊娠（單側劇痛、肩痛、暈厥）
發燒與惡臭分泌物提示感染性流產
確診抗磷脂症候群或血栓病史需專科共同照護
red_flags_en: Acute heavy bleeding or severe pain with dizziness is an emergency — seek immediate care
Suspected ectopic pregnancy (unilateral severe pain, shoulder pain, syncope)
Fever with foul discharge suggests septic miscarriage
Confirmed antiphospholipid syndrome or thrombosis history needs co-managed specialist care
records.western_context_zh: 【習慣性流產（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N96）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Evaluation and management commonly include endocrine and coagulation workup, uterine imaging, and cause-specific support. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 黃體功能不足（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 黃體功能不足（文件情境）指黃體期黃體素分泌不足或內膜反應不良，可能與月經週期偏短、經前點狀出血及受孕／著床困難相關；其獨立診斷標準仍具爭議。
records.summary_en: Luteal phase deficiency (context) refers to inadequate luteal progesterone or endometrial response, potentially linked to short cycles, premenstrual spotting, and difficulty conceiving or implanting. Its status as a discrete diagnosis remains debated.
red_flags_zh: 反覆早期流產需系統性評估
顯著週期紊亂或閉經應重新評估內分泌
疑似懷孕合併出血需排除先兆流產或異位妊娠
red_flags_en: Recurrent early miscarriage warrants systematic evaluation
Marked cycle disruption or amenorrhea — reassess endocrine causes
Possible pregnancy with bleeding — rule out threatened or ectopic pregnancy
records.western_context_zh: 【黃體功能不足（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：E28.8）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly discussed within fertility care regarding luteal support and correction of underlying endocrine factors. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 更年期症候群指停經過渡期因卵巢功能衰退、雌激素下降所引起的一系列症狀，如潮熱、盜汗、睡眠障礙、情緒波動、陰道乾澀與泌尿生殖症狀。
records.summary_en: Menopausal syndrome is the cluster of symptoms during the menopausal transition from declining ovarian function and estrogen, including hot flashes, night sweats, sleep disturbance, mood changes, vaginal dryness, and genitourinary symptoms.
red_flags_zh: 任何停經後陰道出血需評估子宮內膜以排除惡性
40 歲前即出現更年期症狀需評估卵巢早衰
嚴重情緒低落或自殺意念需即時心理支持
新發胸痛、嚴重頭痛或神經症狀不可歸因於更年期，需即時評估
red_flags_en: Any postmenopausal vaginal bleeding — evaluate the endometrium to exclude malignancy
Menopausal symptoms before 40 — evaluate for premature ovarian insufficiency
Severe low mood or suicidal ideation — urgent mental-health support
New chest pain, severe headache, or neurologic symptoms must not be attributed to menopause — evaluate promptly
records.western_context_zh: 【更年期症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N95.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Depending on symptoms and risk, management may include lifestyle measures, non-hormonal agents, hormone therapy, and local treatments. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 妊娠劇吐（文件情境）為妊娠早期嚴重、持續之噁心嘔吐，導致脫水、電解質失衡與體重下降，較一般孕吐嚴重，可能需醫療處置與補液。
records.summary_en: Hyperemesis gravidarum (context) is severe, persistent nausea and vomiting in early pregnancy causing dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, and weight loss — more severe than typical morning sickness and often needing medical management and fluids.
red_flags_zh: 無法進食飲水、少尿、明顯脫水或體重明顯下降需就醫補液
嘔吐物帶血
意識混亂、視力改變或步態不穩需排除電解質／維生素缺乏之神經併發症
發燒或腹痛提示其他病因
red_flags_en: Inability to keep down food/fluids, reduced urine, marked dehydration, or significant weight loss — seek care for rehydration
Blood in vomit
Confusion, vision change, or unsteady gait — rule out neurologic complications of electrolyte/vitamin deficiency
Fever or abdominal pain suggests another cause
records.western_context_zh: 【妊娠劇吐（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：O21）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with rehydration, antiemetics, and nutritional support; severe cases may need admission. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 胎位不正（艾灸文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 胎位不正（艾灸文件情境）指妊娠晚期胎兒非頭位（如臀位），與分娩方式及風險相關；部分傳統做法於特定孕週以艾灸至陰穴輔助，屬受訓醫者臨床決策。
records.summary_en: Breech presentation (moxibustion context) is a non-cephalic fetal lie (e.g., breech) in late pregnancy, relevant to delivery mode and risk. Some traditional approaches use moxibustion at BL67 during a specific gestational window as an adjunct — a trained clinician's decision.
red_flags_zh: 破水合併臍帶脫垂徵象屬產科急症，需立即就醫
規則宮縮或陰道出血提示早產或產兆
胎動明顯減少需即時評估
任何外轉術均應由產科醫師於監測下執行
red_flags_en: Ruptured membranes with signs of cord prolapse is an obstetric emergency — seek immediate care
Regular contractions or vaginal bleeding suggests preterm labor or onset of labor
Marked decrease in fetal movement — evaluate promptly
Any external cephalic version must be performed by an obstetrician under monitoring
records.western_context_zh: 【胎位不正（艾灸文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：O32.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Obstetric care assesses external cephalic version or delivery planning such as cesarean by gestation and circumstances. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 產後缺乳指產後乳汁分泌不足以滿足嬰兒需求，成因包括含乳與哺乳頻率、荷爾蒙、乳腺發育、壓力與疲勞及部分藥物等，需哺乳支持評估。
records.summary_en: Insufficient lactation is inadequate milk production for the infant's needs. Causes include latch and feeding frequency, hormonal factors, breast development, stress and fatigue, and certain medications; lactation-support assessment is helpful.
red_flags_zh: 嬰兒體重不增、尿量少或脫水徵象需小兒科即時評估
乳房紅腫熱痛合併發燒提示乳腺炎
產後大量出血或嚴重情緒低落需即時醫療／心理評估
疑似 Sheehan 症候群（產後大出血後無泌乳）需內分泌評估
red_flags_en: Poor infant weight gain, low urine output, or dehydration — urgent pediatric evaluation
Red, hot, painful breast with fever suggests mastitis
Postpartum hemorrhage or severe low mood — urgent medical/mental-health evaluation
Suspected Sheehan syndrome (no lactation after major postpartum hemorrhage) — endocrine evaluation
records.western_context_zh: 【產後缺乳】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：O92.4）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with lactation guidance, increasing effective feeding, and whole-person support, evaluating underlying causes when needed. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 慢性骨盆腔疼痛指持續六個月以上的骨盆腔疼痛，成因多元（婦科、腸胃、泌尿、肌肉骨骼與神經因素），常需多面向評估與跨科處理。
records.summary_en: Chronic pelvic pain is pelvic pain lasting more than six months with multiple possible sources (gynecologic, gastrointestinal, urologic, musculoskeletal, neurologic), often needing multidimensional assessment and multidisciplinary care.
red_flags_zh: 急性劇痛或痛感型態突變需排除急症（如卵巢扭轉、異位妊娠）
發燒、異常分泌物提示感染
腸道出血、體重減輕或排便習慣改變需排除腸道病變
血尿需泌尿評估
red_flags_en: Acute severe pain or abrupt change in pattern — rule out an acute cause (e.g., torsion, ectopic)
Fever or abnormal discharge suggests infection
Rectal bleeding, weight loss, or bowel-habit change — rule out bowel pathology
Hematuria — urologic evaluation
records.western_context_zh: 【慢性骨盆腔疼痛】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：R10.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management commonly combines pain control, treatment of identifiable causes, and mind-body support. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 慢性骨盆腔炎後遺（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 慢性骨盆腔炎後遺（文件情境）指骨盆腔發炎性疾病後之慢性後遺，如骨盆腔沾黏、慢性疼痛、輸卵管損傷與不孕，多與既往感染史相關。
records.summary_en: Chronic PID sequelae (context) are long-term consequences after pelvic inflammatory disease, such as pelvic adhesions, chronic pain, tubal damage, and infertility, usually linked to prior infection.
red_flags_zh: 發燒、劇烈骨盆腔痛與異常分泌物提示急性發作或膿瘍，需即時就醫
疑似異位妊娠（有輸卵管損傷史者風險升高）
不孕需生殖專科評估
性伴侶需同步篩檢與處理以防再感染
red_flags_en: Fever, severe pelvic pain, and abnormal discharge suggest an acute flare or abscess — seek urgent care
Suspected ectopic pregnancy (higher risk with tubal damage)
Infertility — refer for reproductive evaluation
Partners need concurrent screening/treatment to prevent reinfection
records.western_context_zh: 【慢性骨盆腔炎後遺（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N73.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Acute infection is treated with antibiotics; chronic sequelae often need pain management and fertility-related evaluation. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 外陰陰道念珠菌感染（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 外陰陰道念珠菌感染（文件情境）為念珠菌引起的陰道炎，症狀包括外陰搔癢、灼熱、白色凝乳狀分泌物與紅腫，常見且多可辨識，反覆發作需評估誘因。
records.summary_en: Vulvovaginal candidiasis (context) is a yeast (Candida) vaginitis with vulvar itching, burning, thick white curd-like discharge, and erythema. It is common and usually recognizable; recurrent episodes warrant evaluation of contributors.
red_flags_zh: 反覆或難治性感染需排除糖尿病或免疫低下等誘因
合併發燒、骨盆腔痛提示上生殖道感染，非單純陰道炎
孕期症狀需依醫療指示處理
分泌物型態不符（惡臭、灰綠、泡沫）提示其他病原
red_flags_en: Recurrent or refractory infection — rule out contributors such as diabetes or immunosuppression
Fever or pelvic pain suggests upper-tract infection, not simple vaginitis
Symptoms in pregnancy should be managed per medical guidance
Discharge that doesn't fit (foul, gray-green, frothy) suggests another pathogen
records.western_context_zh: 【外陰陰道念珠菌感染（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：B37.3）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with antifungal agents and addressing contributors. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.name_zh: 子宮內膜偏薄（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 子宮內膜偏薄（文件情境）指於評估時機內膜厚度低於一般著床所需，可能與雌激素不足、宮腔沾黏、既往手術或血流因素相關，主要見於生育與輔助生殖脈絡。
records.summary_en: Thin endometrial lining (context) is endometrial thickness below what is generally favorable for implantation at the assessment time, potentially linked to low estrogen, intrauterine adhesions, prior surgery, or blood-flow factors, mainly relevant in fertility and ART contexts.
red_flags_zh: 有子宮腔手術史且經量驟減提示宮腔沾黏，需宮腔評估
反覆著床失敗需生殖專科評估
異常出血需排除內膜病變
red_flags_en: Prior uterine surgery with a sharp drop in flow suggests intrauterine adhesions — assess the cavity
Recurrent implantation failure — refer to reproductive medicine
Abnormal bleeding — rule out endometrial pathology
records.western_context_zh: 【子宮內膜偏薄（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N85.8）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly discussed within reproductive care regarding estrogen support, cavity assessment, and strategies to improve the lining. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 經前不悅症（文件情境）為經前症候群之嚴重型，以黃體期顯著情緒症狀（易怒、情緒低落、焦慮、失控感）為主，明顯影響人際與功能，月經來潮後緩解。
records.summary_en: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (context) is a severe form of PMS dominated by marked luteal-phase mood symptoms (irritability, low mood, anxiety, feeling out of control) that impair relationships and function and remit after menses.
red_flags_zh: 自殺意念、自傷或絕望感需即時精神科／危機介入
症狀無週期性或整月持續，應重新評估是否為其他情緒疾患
症狀急遽惡化影響安全
red_flags_en: Suicidal ideation, self-harm, or hopelessness — urgent psychiatric/crisis intervention
Non-cyclical or month-long symptoms — reassess for another mood disorder
Rapid worsening affecting safety
records.western_context_zh: 【經前不悅症（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：F32.81）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Commonly managed with serotonergic agents, hormonal approaches, and psychological support. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 繼發性痛經指由骨盆腔器質病變（如子宮內膜異位、子宮腺肌症、肌瘤、骨盆腔炎或宮內裝置）引起的經期疼痛，常於成年後新發或型態改變，需查明病因。
records.summary_en: Secondary dysmenorrhea is menstrual pain caused by pelvic pathology (endometriosis, adenomyosis, fibroids, PID, or an intrauterine device), often new-onset in adulthood or with a changed pattern, requiring identification of the cause.
red_flags_zh: 進行性加重或止痛無效之痛經需影像與專科評估
發燒、異常分泌物提示感染
劇痛合併異常出血或疑似懷孕需排除急症
深部性交痛與腸道／膀胱周期症狀提示內膜異位深部浸潤
red_flags_en: Progressive or analgesia-resistant pain — imaging and specialist evaluation
Fever or abnormal discharge suggests infection
Severe pain with abnormal bleeding or possible pregnancy — rule out acute causes
Deep dyspareunia with cyclical bowel/bladder symptoms suggests deep infiltrating endometriosis
records.western_context_zh: 【繼發性痛經】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：N94.5）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Management targets the underlying cause with adjunctive pain control. Documentation context only, not a treatment instruction.

records.summary_zh: 持續逾三個月的下背痛，多為非特異性（無明確結構病灶），與肌肉失衡、姿勢、心理社會因素相關。症狀時輕時重，久坐久站或前彎加重。
records.summary_en: Low back pain persisting beyond three months, most often non-specific (no identifiable structural lesion), linked to muscle imbalance, posture and psychosocial factors. Symptoms fluctuate and worsen with prolonged sitting, standing or forward bending.
red_flags_zh: 鞍區麻木、大小便失禁 → 馬尾症候群，急診
夜間痛、體重減輕、癌症病史 → 排除轉移或腫瘤
發燒、靜脈藥癮、免疫低下 → 排除脊椎感染
重大外傷或骨鬆長者輕微外力後痛 → 排除壓迫性骨折
red_flags_en: Saddle anaesthesia, bowel/bladder incontinence → cauda equina, emergency
Night pain, weight loss, cancer history → rule out metastasis or tumour
Fever, IV drug use, immunosuppression → rule out spinal infection
Major trauma, or minor force in osteoporotic elderly → rule out compression fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【慢性下背痛】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M54.5）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Guidelines agree: no early imaging without red flags. Core management is staying active, exercise therapy and education, avoiding bed rest. Chronicity is closely tied to psychosocial factors.

records.summary_zh: 腰部肌肉或韌帶因突發用力、扭轉或搬重而拉傷。症狀為急性局部腰痛、肌肉緊繃痙攣、活動受限，通常無下肢放射痛。
records.summary_en: Strain of the lumbar muscles or ligaments from sudden effort, twisting or lifting. Presents with acute localised low back pain, muscle guarding and spasm, and restricted motion, usually without leg radiation.
red_flags_zh: 下肢放射痛或麻木無力 → 考慮神經根受壓而非單純拉傷
馬尾徵象（鞍麻、失禁）→ 急診
外傷後劇痛無法負重 → 排除骨折
red_flags_en: Radiating leg pain or numbness/weakness → consider nerve root involvement, not simple strain
Cauda equina signs (saddle numbness, incontinence) → emergency
Severe pain unable to bear weight after trauma → rule out fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【急性腰扭傷】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：S39.012）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most resolve within days to weeks. Early relative activity, analgesia and heat beat bed rest; recurrent cases need core and movement training.

records.summary_zh: 腰椎間盤纖維環破裂、髓核突出壓迫神經根（多為 L4/5、L5/S1）。症狀為單側下肢放射痛（坐骨神經痛型），咳嗽、久坐、前彎加重，可伴皮節麻木與肌力下降。
records.summary_en: Rupture of the annulus with nucleus pulposus herniation compressing a nerve root (usually L4/5, L5/S1). Causes unilateral radicular leg pain worse with coughing, sitting and bending, sometimes with dermatomal numbness and weakness.
red_flags_zh: 馬尾症候群（鞍麻、失禁、雙側無力）→ 急診手術
進行性足下垂或明顯肌力下降 → 神經外科評估
發燒或癌症病史 → 排除感染或腫瘤
red_flags_en: Cauda equina syndrome (saddle numbness, incontinence, bilateral weakness) → emergency surgery
Progressive foot drop or marked weakness → neurosurgical assessment
Fever or cancer history → rule out infection or tumour
records.western_context_zh: 【腰椎椎間盤突出】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M51.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most herniations improve within 6–12 weeks as they resorb; conservative care is first-line. Surgery is reserved for progressive deficit, cauda equina, or refractory sciatica.

records.summary_zh: 坐骨神經或其神經根（多為 L4–S1）受壓或刺激所致的下肢放射痛，常沿臀部、大腿後側至小腿、足部，可伴麻木或無力。最常見成因為腰椎間盤突出。
records.summary_en: Radiating leg pain from compression or irritation of the sciatic nerve or its roots (usually L4–S1), travelling from the buttock down the posterior thigh to the calf and foot, sometimes with numbness or weakness. The commonest cause is lumbar disc herniation.
red_flags_zh: 鞍區麻木、大小便失禁或滯留、雙下肢無力 → 馬尾症候群，急診轉介
進行性足下垂或明顯肌力下降 → 需影像與神經外科評估
夜間痛合併體重減輕、發燒或癌症病史 → 排除腫瘤或感染
red_flags_en: Saddle anaesthesia, bowel or bladder incontinence/retention, bilateral leg weakness → cauda equina syndrome, emergency referral
Progressive foot drop or marked motor loss → needs imaging and neurosurgical assessment
Night pain with weight loss, fever, or cancer history → rule out tumour or infection
records.western_context_zh: 【坐骨神經痛】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M54.3）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most disc-related sciatica improves within 6–12 weeks with analgesia, staying active, nerve mobilisation and physiotherapy. The red-flag features are the only part that demands immediate action.

records.summary_zh: 頸椎退化性變化（椎間盤、骨刺、關節突）。症狀為頸部僵硬痠痛、活動受限，可壓迫神經根致上肢放射痛麻，或壓迫脊髓致脊髓病變。
records.summary_en: Age-related degenerative change of the cervical spine (discs, osteophytes, facets). Causes neck stiffness and ache with restricted motion; may compress nerve roots (radiculopathy) or the cord (myelopathy).
red_flags_zh: 步態不穩、手部精細動作變差、Hoffmann/Babinski 陽性 → 脊髓病變，需影像與轉介
進行性上肢無力或萎縮 → 神經根/脊髓受壓
發燒、體重減輕 → 排除感染或腫瘤
red_flags_en: Unsteady gait, clumsy hands, positive Hoffmann/Babinski → cervical myelopathy, image and refer
Progressive arm weakness or wasting → root/cord compression
Fever, weight loss → rule out infection or tumour
records.western_context_zh: 【頸椎病】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M47.812）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Imaging degeneration and symptoms often diverge. Most neck pain and radiculopathy improve conservatively; myelopathy is a surgical indication and should not be delayed.

records.summary_zh: 急性頸部疼痛與僵硬（俗稱落枕），多因睡姿、受寒或輕微拉傷致肌肉痙攣。症狀為單側頸痛、轉頭受限，通常數日內緩解。
records.summary_en: Acute neck pain and stiffness (wry neck / acute torticollis), often from sleep posture, cold exposure or minor strain causing muscle spasm. Presents with one-sided neck pain and limited rotation, usually settling within days.
red_flags_zh: 發燒合併頸部僵硬、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎（急症）
外傷後頸痛 → 排除骨折或韌帶損傷，勿貿然活動
上肢放射麻木無力 → 考慮神經根病變
red_flags_en: Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia → rule out meningitis (emergency)
Neck pain after trauma → rule out fracture or ligament injury, do not force motion
Radiating arm numbness/weakness → consider radiculopathy
records.western_context_zh: 【急性頸痛／落枕】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M54.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Benign cases improve with continued motion, heat and gentle stretching, avoiding prolonged immobilisation. Recurrence relates to posture and stress.

records.name_zh: 揮鞭式頸部損傷（文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 頸部因加速—減速（多為車禍追撞）造成的軟組織損傷。症狀常延遲數小時至一日出現：頸痛僵硬、頭痛、活動受限，可伴頭暈。
records.summary_en: Soft-tissue neck injury from an acceleration–deceleration mechanism (typically rear-end collision). Symptoms often appear hours to a day later: neck pain and stiffness, headache, restricted motion, sometimes dizziness.
red_flags_zh: 中線骨性壓痛、麻木無力、意識改變（加拿大頸椎準則陽性）→ 影像排除骨折/脫位
進行性神經症狀 → 神經外科評估
劇烈頭痛或吞嚥、發聲異常 → 排除血管損傷
red_flags_en: Midline bony tenderness, numbness/weakness, altered consciousness (positive Canadian C-spine rule) → image to exclude fracture/dislocation
Progressive neurological symptoms → neurosurgical assessment
Severe headache or swallowing/voice change → rule out vascular injury
records.western_context_zh: 【揮鞭式頸部損傷（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：S13.4）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most are grade I–II (no fracture or neurological injury); early activity, education and avoiding over-immobilisation improve outcome. Fear-avoidance and excessive rest prolong recovery.

records.summary_zh: 肩關節囊發炎、纖維化、攣縮，導致肩部漸進性疼痛與各方向主動、被動活動皆受限。病程分疼痛期、僵硬期、緩解期，可歷時一至三年。
records.summary_en: Inflammation, fibrosis and contracture of the shoulder capsule causing progressive pain and loss of both active AND passive range in all directions. It runs through freezing, frozen and thawing phases over one to three years.
red_flags_zh: 外傷後突發無力或畸形 → 排除旋轉肌撕裂或骨折
夜間痛合併體重減輕或發燒 → 排除感染或腫瘤
被動活動不受限卻無力 → 可能是旋轉肌問題而非冰凍肩
red_flags_en: Sudden weakness or deformity after trauma → rule out rotator cuff tear or fracture
Night pain with weight loss or fever → rule out infection or tumour
Full passive range but weakness → likely rotator cuff, not adhesive capsulitis
records.western_context_zh: 【五十肩／冷凍肩】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M75.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most common in ages 40–60, women, and people with diabetes or thyroid disease. Key discriminator from rotator cuff disease: passive range is also limited. Usually self-limiting; managed with physiotherapy and intra-articular injection.

records.summary_zh: 旋轉肌腱（棘上肌最常見）因退化或夾擠而肌腱病變，甚至撕裂。症狀為肩外側痛、過頭動作與夜間側睡加重、外展無力。
records.summary_en: Tendinopathy or tearing of the rotator cuff tendons (most often supraspinatus) from degeneration or impingement. Presents with lateral shoulder pain worse on overhead reach and when lying on the side, with weakness in abduction.
red_flags_zh: 急性外傷後無法主動外展手臂 → 疑全層撕裂，需影像與轉介
合併頸部放射痛或手麻 → 排除頸神經根病變
夜間痛合併發燒 → 排除感染
red_flags_en: Cannot actively abduct the arm after acute trauma → suspect full-thickness tear, image and refer
With radiating neck pain or hand numbness → rule out cervical radiculopathy
Night pain with fever → rule out infection
records.western_context_zh: 【旋轉肌袖肌腱病變】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M75.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Increasingly common with age. Special tests (empty-can/Jobe, Hawkins-Kennedy, painful arc) are interpreted in clusters, not singly. Most partial-thickness lesions improve with rehabilitation; full-thickness tears may need repair.

records.summary_zh: 前臂伸腕肌總腱起點（肱骨外上髁，以橈側伸腕短肌為主）的過度使用性肌腱病變，俗稱網球肘。症狀為外上髁壓痛、抗阻伸腕或握物時痛。
records.summary_en: Overuse tendinopathy at the common extensor origin on the lateral epicondyle (chiefly ECRB), known as tennis elbow. Presents with tenderness over the lateral epicondyle and pain on resisted wrist extension or gripping.
red_flags_zh: 外上髁腫脹發熱 → 排除感染或發炎性關節病
合併手麻或無力 → 排除橈神經（後骨間神經）夾擠
外傷後劇痛 → 排除撕脫性骨折
red_flags_en: Warmth and swelling over the epicondyle → rule out infection or inflammatory arthropathy
With hand numbness or weakness → rule out radial (posterior interosseous) nerve entrapment
Severe pain after trauma → rule out avulsion fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【網球肘】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M77.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: It is tendinosis (degeneration), not true inflammation, so despite the '-itis' name the pathology is degenerative. Most improve with relative rest, eccentric loading and bracing; the natural course can exceed a year.

records.summary_zh: 前臂屈腕/旋前肌總腱起點（肱骨內上髁）的過度使用性肌腱病變，俗稱高爾夫球肘。症狀為內上髁壓痛，抗阻屈腕或旋前、握抓時加重。
records.summary_en: Overuse tendinopathy at the common flexor–pronator origin on the medial epicondyle, known as golfer's elbow. Presents with medial epicondyle tenderness, worse on resisted wrist flexion/pronation and gripping.
red_flags_zh: 合併第四、五指麻木無力 → 排除尺神經（肘管）病變
紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染
外傷後劇痛 → 排除撕脫性骨折
red_flags_en: With numbness/weakness of the ring and little fingers → rule out ulnar nerve (cubital tunnel) involvement
Redness, warmth, swelling → rule out infection
Severe pain after trauma → rule out avulsion fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【高爾夫球肘】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M77.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Like tennis elbow, this is tendinosis. Most improve with relative rest, eccentric loading and bracing; watch for the adjacent ulnar nerve.

records.summary_zh: 正中神經於腕隧道內受壓迫。症狀為拇、食、中指及無名指橈側麻木刺痛，夜間及甩手時明顯，晚期可見大魚際肌萎縮與握力下降。
records.summary_en: Compression of the median nerve within the carpal tunnel. Causes numbness and tingling in the thumb, index, middle and radial ring finger, worse at night and relieved by shaking the hand; late signs include thenar wasting and grip weakness.
red_flags_zh: 進行性大魚際肌萎縮或持續麻木 → 需神經傳導檢查與轉介，考慮手術減壓
雙側合併全身症狀 → 排除甲狀腺低下、類風濕、澱粉樣變
外傷後急性腫脹麻木 → 排除急性腕隧道症候群（急症）
red_flags_en: Progressive thenar wasting or constant numbness → needs nerve conduction study and referral; consider surgical release
Bilateral with systemic symptoms → rule out hypothyroidism, rheumatoid arthritis, amyloidosis
Acute swelling and numbness after trauma → rule out acute carpal tunnel syndrome (emergency)
records.western_context_zh: 【腕隧道症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：G56.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Provocative tests (Phalen, Tinel) have limited sensitivity; diagnosis is confirmed by nerve conduction studies. Mild cases improve with night splinting and activity change; persistent cases or those with wasting respond well to surgical release.

records.summary_zh: 腕橈側第一背側腔室（拇長展肌與拇短伸肌腱）的狹窄性腱鞘炎。症狀為橈側腕痛，拇指活動與握抓、抱嬰兒時加重，Finkelstein 測試陽性。
records.summary_en: Stenosing tenosynovitis of the first dorsal compartment at the radial wrist (abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis). Causes radial wrist pain worse with thumb movement, gripping and lifting infants; Finkelstein test is positive.
red_flags_zh: 紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染性腱鞘炎（急症）
合併麻木 → 排除橈神經淺支刺激
外傷後劇痛 → 排除橈骨莖突骨折
red_flags_en: Redness, warmth and swelling → rule out infectious tenosynovitis (emergency)
With numbness → rule out superficial radial nerve irritation
Severe pain after trauma → rule out radial styloid fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【媽媽手（狹窄性腱鞘炎）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M65.4）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Common postpartum, in infant carers, and with repetitive thumb use. Managed with splinting, activity modification and injection; refractory cases have surgical release of the compartment.

records.summary_zh: 屈指肌腱與 A1 滑車間的狹窄性腱鞘炎，肌腱通過受阻。症狀為手指屈伸時卡頓、彈響，晨間僵硬，嚴重時手指鎖在屈曲位需被動扳開。
records.summary_en: Stenosing tenosynovitis between the flexor tendon and the A1 pulley, obstructing tendon glide. Causes catching or snapping on finger movement, morning stiffness, and in severe cases the finger locks in flexion requiring passive release.
red_flags_zh: 紅熱腫脹 → 排除感染性腱鞘炎（急症）
外傷後鎖住 → 排除肌腱斷裂或異物
多指同時受累 → 考慮糖尿病、類風濕等全身病因
red_flags_en: Redness, warmth, swelling → rule out infectious tenosynovitis (emergency)
Locking after trauma → rule out tendon rupture or foreign body
Multiple fingers involved → consider systemic causes such as diabetes or rheumatoid arthritis
records.western_context_zh: 【扳機指】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M65.3）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Common in people with diabetes. Mild cases improve with splinting, activity modification and injection; recurrent or locked digits have A1 pulley release.

records.summary_zh: 膝關節軟骨退化磨損伴骨質增生。症狀為活動後痛、晨僵通常少於 30 分鐘、上下樓與蹲起困難，可有摩擦感與腫脹。
records.summary_en: Degenerative wear of knee cartilage with bony overgrowth. Presents with activity-related pain, morning stiffness usually under 30 minutes, difficulty with stairs and squatting, and sometimes crepitus and swelling.
red_flags_zh: 紅、熱、劇痛、發燒 → 排除化膿性關節炎或痛風（急症）
外傷後鎖住或明顯不穩 → 排除半月板或韌帶損傷
晨僵超過一小時、多關節對稱 → 排除類風濕性關節炎
red_flags_en: Red, hot, severely painful joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis or gout (emergency)
Locking or gross instability after trauma → rule out meniscal or ligament injury
Morning stiffness over an hour, symmetric polyarthritis → rule out rheumatoid arthritis
records.western_context_zh: 【膝骨關節炎】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M17）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Risk factors: age, obesity, prior joint injury, malalignment. Cornerstones are exercise therapy and weight loss; medication and injections are adjuncts, with joint replacement for end-stage disease.

records.summary_zh: 髕骨與股骨滑車間的前膝疼痛，與髕骨軌跡不良、肌力失衡（股內側肌、髖外展肌無力）相關。症狀為上下樓、蹲、久坐後膝前痛（劇院徵）。
records.summary_en: Anterior knee pain at the patellofemoral joint, linked to poor patellar tracking and muscle imbalance (weak VMO, hip abductors). Presents with pain on stairs, squatting and after prolonged sitting (theatre sign).
red_flags_zh: 關節腫脹積液 → 排除關節內損傷（半月板、軟骨）
鎖住或打軟 → 排除半月板或韌帶問題
紅熱發燒 → 排除感染性關節炎
red_flags_en: Joint effusion → rule out intra-articular injury (meniscus, cartilage)
Locking or giving way → rule out meniscal or ligament problem
Red, hot joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis
records.western_context_zh: 【髕股疼痛症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M22.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Exercise therapy is the cornerstone (quadriceps, hip abductor/external rotator strengthening, movement correction); most need neither surgery nor imaging.

records.summary_zh: 膝半月軟骨因扭轉或退化而撕裂。症狀為關節線壓痛、腫脹、鎖住或打軟，蹲與旋轉加重；McMurray 測試可陽性。
records.summary_en: Tear of the knee meniscus from twisting or degeneration. Presents with joint-line tenderness, swelling, locking or giving way, worse with squatting and rotation; McMurray test may be positive.
red_flags_zh: 真正鎖住無法伸直 → 桶柄狀撕裂，需轉介評估
外傷後大量積血（數小時內腫脹）→ 排除韌帶斷裂或骨軟骨骨折
紅熱發燒 → 排除感染
red_flags_en: True locking with inability to extend → bucket-handle tear, refer for assessment
Large haemarthrosis (swelling within hours) after trauma → rule out ligament rupture or osteochondral fracture
Red, hot joint with fever → rule out infection
records.western_context_zh: 【半月板損傷（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：S83.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Degenerative tears often improve with rehabilitation and may not need surgery. Special tests (McMurray, Thessaly) are read in combination; MRI confirms structure but does not replace clinical judgment.

records.summary_zh: 踝關節韌帶（最常為外側距腓前韌帶）因內翻扭傷而拉傷或撕裂。症狀為外踝腫脹、瘀青、壓痛與負重困難。
records.summary_en: Stretch or tear of the ankle ligaments (most often the anterior talofibular ligament) from an inversion injury. Presents with lateral ankle swelling, bruising, tenderness and difficulty bearing weight.
red_flags_zh: 受傷後無法負重四步且骨性壓痛（Ottawa 踝準則陽性）→ 需 X 光排除骨折
明顯不穩或反覆扭傷 → 考慮韌帶完全斷裂或慢性不穩
近端腓骨壓痛 → 排除 Maisonneuve 骨折
red_flags_en: Unable to take four steps and bony tenderness (positive Ottawa ankle rules) → X-ray to exclude fracture
Gross instability or recurrent sprains → consider complete ligament rupture or chronic instability
Proximal fibular tenderness → rule out Maisonneuve fracture
records.western_context_zh: 【踝關節扭傷】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：S93.4）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Functional rehabilitation (early motion, balance and peroneal strengthening) beats prolonged immobilisation. Most recover within weeks; skipping rehab risks chronic ankle instability.

records.summary_zh: 足底筋膜（支撐足弓、連接跟骨與前足的強韌帶）因過度負荷而發炎、退化。典型症狀是晨起或久坐後起身「頭幾步」跟部劇痛，行走數分鐘後緩解。
records.summary_en: Irritation and degeneration of the plantar fascia, the strong band supporting the arch from heel to forefoot. The hallmark is sharp heel pain with the first few steps after rest that eases within minutes of walking.
red_flags_zh: 夜間痛或休息痛、外傷後無法負重 → 排除跟骨應力性骨折
雙側跟痛合併其他關節症狀 → 考慮發炎性關節病（如僵直性脊椎炎）
足底麻木或灼痛 → 考慮神經夾擠而非筋膜炎
red_flags_en: Night or rest pain, or inability to bear weight after trauma → rule out calcaneal stress fracture
Bilateral heel pain with other joint symptoms → consider inflammatory arthropathy (e.g. ankylosing spondylitis)
Plantar numbness or burning → consider nerve entrapment rather than fasciitis
records.western_context_zh: 【足底筋膜炎】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M72.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Risk factors: tight calf, flat or high-arched feet, obesity, prolonged standing on hard surfaces, age 40–60. Over 90% improve within 10 months with conservative care (stretching, arch support, load reduction); surgery is rarely needed.

records.summary_zh: 跟腱因過度使用而退化性病變，分為腱中段型與跟骨止端型。症狀為跟腱疼痛僵硬，運動初期加重、熱身後略緩，局部可增厚壓痛。
records.summary_en: Overuse degeneration of the Achilles tendon, either mid-portion or insertional. Presents with tendon pain and stiffness worse at the start of activity and easing with warm-up, often with local thickening and tenderness.
red_flags_zh: 突發後跟「被踢」感、無法墊腳、Thompson 測試陽性 → 跟腱斷裂，需轉介
紅熱腫脹合併發燒 → 排除感染
使用氟喹諾酮類抗生素 → 肌腱斷裂風險升高，須警覺
red_flags_en: Sudden 'kicked in the heel' sensation, inability to push off, positive Thompson test → Achilles rupture, refer
Redness, warmth and swelling with fever → rule out infection
On fluoroquinolone antibiotics → heightened rupture risk, stay alert
records.western_context_zh: 【阿基里斯腱病變】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M76.6）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: The cornerstone is eccentric calf loading and load management. Being degenerative rather than inflammatory, corticosteroid injection into the tendon body is discouraged (rupture risk). Recovery is measured in months.

records.summary_zh: 髖關節軟骨退化。症狀為腹股溝痛（可轉移至大腿、膝），活動後加重、晨僵短暫，內旋與屈曲受限，行走漸困難。
records.summary_en: Degenerative wear of the hip joint. Causes groin pain (may refer to thigh and knee), worse with activity, brief morning stiffness, limited internal rotation and flexion, and progressive difficulty walking.
red_flags_zh: 休息痛、夜間痛、體重減輕 → 排除腫瘤或感染
突發劇痛無法負重（尤其類固醇/酒精史）→ 排除股骨頭缺血性壞死或骨折
紅熱發燒 → 排除化膿性關節炎
red_flags_en: Rest or night pain with weight loss → rule out tumour or infection
Sudden severe pain unable to bear weight (esp. steroid/alcohol history) → rule out avascular necrosis or fracture
Red, hot joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis
records.western_context_zh: 【髖骨關節炎】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M16）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Cornerstones are exercise and weight loss with medication as adjunct; end-stage disease responds well to hip replacement. Groin pain rather than lateral pain better fits a true hip source.

records.summary_zh: 梨狀肌緊繃或痙攣壓迫其下方坐骨神經，造成臀部深部痛並可沿下肢放射，久坐、爬樓、髖外旋抗阻加重。屬排除性診斷。
records.summary_en: Tightness or spasm of piriformis compressing the sciatic nerve beneath it, causing deep buttock pain that may radiate down the leg, worse with prolonged sitting, stairs and resisted hip external rotation. A diagnosis of exclusion.
red_flags_zh: 腰痛合併皮節分布麻木無力 → 優先排除腰椎神經根病變
馬尾徵象 → 急診
夜間痛、體重減輕 → 排除骨盆腫瘤
red_flags_en: Back pain with dermatomal numbness/weakness → first rule out lumbar radiculopathy
Cauda equina signs → emergency
Night pain, weight loss → rule out pelvic tumour
records.western_context_zh: 【梨狀肌症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：G57.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Lumbar-source sciatica must be excluded first. Management centres on stretching, gluteal and core training, and movement correction.

records.summary_zh: 以廣泛性慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛為核心的中樞敏感化症候群，伴疲勞、非恢復性睡眠、認知障礙（腦霧）。無特異影像或血液異常，屬臨床診斷。
records.summary_en: A central sensitisation syndrome centred on widespread chronic musculoskeletal pain, with fatigue, non-restorative sleep and cognitive difficulty (fog). There is no specific imaging or blood abnormality; it is a clinical diagnosis.
red_flags_zh: 發燒、體重減輕、關節腫脹、皮疹 → 排除發炎性/自體免疫疾病
近端無力、肌酵素升高 → 排除肌炎
局部固定痛而非廣泛痛 → 重新考慮結構性病因
red_flags_en: Fever, weight loss, joint swelling, rash → rule out inflammatory/autoimmune disease
Proximal weakness with raised muscle enzymes → rule out myositis
Fixed focal pain rather than widespread → reconsider a structural cause
records.western_context_zh: 【纖維肌痛症】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M79.7）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Diagnosis uses the ACR widespread pain index and symptom scale. Management centres on exercise (aerobic and graded), sleep and education, with medication as adjunct.

records.summary_zh: 肌筋膜激痛點（緊繃帶內的過敏點）引起的局部與轉移痛。症狀為特定肌肉壓痛、按壓可誘發轉移痛與局部抽動，活動範圍略受限。
records.summary_en: Regional and referred pain from myofascial trigger points (hyperirritable spots within taut bands). Presents with focal muscle tenderness, a referred pain pattern and local twitch on palpation, with mildly limited range.
red_flags_zh: 合併全身廣泛壓痛、疲勞、睡眠障礙 → 考慮纖維肌痛而非局部肌筋膜痛
發燒、體重減輕 → 排除感染或腫瘤
進行性神經症狀 → 排除神經根或脊髓病變
red_flags_en: Widespread tenderness, fatigue and sleep disturbance → consider fibromyalgia rather than localised myofascial pain
Fever, weight loss → rule out infection or tumour
Progressive neurological symptoms → rule out radiculopathy or myelopathy
records.western_context_zh: 【肌筋膜疼痛症候群】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M79.1）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Overlaps strongly with acupuncture ashi points and the sinew-channel (jingjin) concept. Treatment includes trigger-point work (dry needling, pressure), stretching and posture correction.

records.summary_zh: 顳顎關節與咀嚼肌功能障礙。症狀為顎關節或咀嚼肌痛、開口受限或偏移、關節彈響、咀嚼與說話時加重，可伴頭痛耳前痛。
records.summary_en: Dysfunction of the temporomandibular joint and masticatory muscles. Presents with joint or muscle pain, limited or deviating mouth opening, clicking, worse with chewing and talking, sometimes with headache and preauricular pain.
red_flags_zh: 顎關節鎖死無法開口/閉口 → 需轉介
外傷後咬合改變或劇痛 → 排除下頜骨折或脫位
進行性面部麻木無力 → 排除神經或腫瘤病因
red_flags_en: Jaw locked open or closed → refer
Bite change or severe pain after trauma → rule out mandibular fracture or dislocation
Progressive facial numbness/weakness → rule out neurological or tumour cause
records.western_context_zh: 【顳顎關節障礙】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：M26.6）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Most cases are benign and self-limiting, improving with education, soft diet, jaw exercises, stress management and a night guard. Closely tied to the masticatory muscles (CN V innervation).

records.summary_zh: 最常見的原發性頭痛。雙側、壓迫或緊箍樣、輕至中度、不因日常活動加重，無明顯噁心嘔吐。常與壓力、姿勢、頸肩肌緊繃相關。
records.summary_en: The most common primary headache. Bilateral, pressing or tightening, mild to moderate, not aggravated by routine activity, without significant nausea or vomiting. Often linked to stress, posture and neck-shoulder muscle tension.
red_flags_zh: 霹靂性（瞬間達最強）頭痛 → 排除蛛網膜下腔出血（急症）
發燒合併頸僵、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎
新發於 50 歲以上、漸進惡化、神經缺損、清晨嘔吐 → 影像排除腫瘤/顱內壓升高
red_flags_en: Thunderclap (instant maximal) headache → rule out subarachnoid haemorrhage (emergency)
Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia → rule out meningitis
New onset over age 50, progressive, focal deficit, morning vomiting → image to exclude tumour/raised ICP
records.western_context_zh: 【緊張型頭痛】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：G44.2）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Diagnosed clinically per the International Classification of Headache Disorders (ICHD-3). Management centres on lifestyle, stress and posture; avoid analgesic overuse leading to medication-overuse headache.

records.summary_zh: 偏頭痛為常見的原發性頭痛，特徵為反覆發作的中至重度搏動性單側頭痛，常伴嘔吐、畏光、畏聲，部分伴有視覺預兆。中醫歸屬於「偏頭痛」、「頭風」，主因肝陽上亢、風寒/風熱襲絡或痰濁瘀血阻絡。
records.summary_en: Migraine is a primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent moderate-to-severe throbbing unilateral headaches, commonly accompanied by nausea, photophobia, and phonophobia, sometimes with aura.
red_flags_zh: 突發一生中最劇烈之霹靂頭痛（Thunderclap headache）需排除蛛網膜下腔出血
伴隨發燒、頸部僵硬、意識模糊需排除腦膜炎
50歲以上新發頭痛或伴發顳動脈壓痛需排除顳動脈炎
伴單側肢體無力、視力喪失等神經缺損症狀
red_flags_en: Sudden onset 'thunderclap' headache — rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage
Fever, nuchal rigidity, or altered consciousness — rule out meningitis
New headache onset after age 50 or temporal tenderness — rule out giant cell arteritis
Focal neurological deficits such as hemiparesis or vision loss
records.western_context_zh: 急性期選用 Triptans 類藥物或 NSAIDs，預防性治療包含 Beta 阻斷劑、CGRP 抗體等（偏頭痛/G43）；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Acute attacks treated with triptans or NSAIDs; prophylaxis includes beta-blockers or CGRP monoclonal antibodies. Documentation context only.

records.summary_zh: 嚴重的單側原發性頭痛，痛在眼眶/顳部，伴同側自律神經徵象（流淚、鼻塞、眼瞼下垂）。發作短（15–180 分鐘）而密集成群，患者常躁動難安。
records.summary_en: A severe unilateral primary headache around the eye/temple with ipsilateral autonomic signs (tearing, nasal congestion, ptosis). Attacks are short (15–180 minutes) and cluster in bouts; sufferers are typically restless and agitated.
red_flags_zh: 首次發作或型態改變 → 影像排除次發性病因（如海綿竇病灶）
霹靂性頭痛 → 排除出血（急症）
持續神經缺損 → 進一步評估
red_flags_en: First-ever attack or change in pattern → image to exclude a secondary cause (e.g. cavernous sinus lesion)
Thunderclap headache → rule out haemorrhage (emergency)
Persistent neurological deficit → further assessment
records.western_context_zh: 【叢發性頭痛（文件情境）】西醫臨床對照與診斷參考（ICD參考代碼：G44.0）：西醫臨床診斷主要依據詳細病史、理學檢查及相關影像與實驗室檢驗，並依症狀選擇藥物、復健或外科處置；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: One of the trigeminal autonomic cephalalgias. Acute treatment is high-flow oxygen and subcutaneous triptan, with preventive medication needed. This is a neurology condition, not simple muscle tension.

records.summary_zh: 痛風（文件情境）為臨床常見病症，屬於pain_msk範疇。中醫學認為本病多由臟腑功能失調、氣血陰陽失衡或外邪侵襲所致，需辨證論治，隨證加減。
records.summary_en: Gout (context) is a clinical condition categorized under pain_msk. In TCM theory, it relates to organ dysfunction and pattern imbalance requiring pattern differentiation.
red_flags_zh: 病情急劇惡化、伴高燒或生命徵象不穩定需緊急轉介急診（【痛風（文件情境）】紅旗警訊）
出現神經學缺損、劇烈疼痛或持續出血等危急徵象需排除器官重大器質性病變
疑似懷孕或有嚴重心肝腎功能不全者需專科評估
red_flags_en: Rapid clinical deterioration or unstable vital signs — urgent ER transfer required
Focal neurological signs or intractable severe pain — rule out acute organic lesion
Pregnancy or end-stage renal/hepatic impairment — specialist consultation indicated

records.summary_zh: 胃食道逆流（GERD）指胃內容物逆流至食道引起灼熱感（胃灼熱）與胃酸逆流。中醫歸屬於「胃脘痛」、「吞酸」、「吐酸」，主因脾胃虛弱、肝氣犯胃或胃氣上逆。
records.summary_en: GERD occurs when stomach contents reflux into the esophagus, causing heartburn and acid regurgitation. TCM categorizes it under Epigastric Pain, Acid Regurgitation, and Rebellious Stomach Qi.

非預期體重減輕或嘔吐不止

records.summary_zh: 功能性消化不良是腸腦互動障礙之一，可見上腹疼痛、灼熱或不適、進食時過早飽足、少量進食後仍感過飽，以及腹脹、噁心或噯氣等症狀。此為學習與文件對照摘要，不取代臨床診斷。
records.summary_en: Functional dyspepsia is a disorder of gut-brain interaction. Symptoms may include upper-abdominal pain, burning or discomfort, early satiety, uncomfortable post-meal fullness, bloating, nausea, or belching. Study and documentation context only; not a diagnostic substitute.

黑色柏油樣糞便

Difficulty or pain with swallowing
Frequent vomiting or bloody vomit
Severe and constant abdominal pain
Shortness of breath

Black, tarry stools

records.summary_en: Trigeminal neuralgia causes sudden, severe facial pain often described as sharp, shooting, or electric-shock-like. It usually affects one side and may last from a few seconds to about two minutes. Washing, eating, brushing the teeth, light touch, or wind may trigger attacks. Study and documentation context only; not a diagnostic substitute.

red_flags_en: Frequent or persistent facial pain should be medically assessed, particularly when standard painkillers do not help and dental causes have been ruled out

records.name_zh: 原發性高血壓（輔助文件情境）
records.summary_zh: 高血壓（原發性高血壓）指收縮壓≥140mmHg 或舒張壓≥90mmHg。中醫歸屬於「頭痛」、「眩暈」，常見病機為肝陽上亢、肝腎陰虛、痰濕中阻及陰陽兩虛。
records.summary_en: Hypertension refers to persistent blood pressure elevation. TCM categorizes it under Vertigo and Headache, primarily driven by Liver Yang Hyperactivity, Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency, or Phlegm-Dampness.
red_flags_zh: 血壓急劇升高（收縮壓>180 或舒張壓>120）伴劇烈頭痛、視力模糊或胸痛（高血壓急症）需即刻送急診
突發單側肢體無力、言語不清或口眼喎斜（疑腦中風）
伴呼吸困難、端坐呼吸或肺部濕囉音（疑急性心臟衰竭/肺水腫）
red_flags_en: Hypertensive emergency (BP >180/120 with headache, vision loss, chest pain) — immediate ER transfer
Focal weakness, slurred speech, facial droop — acute stroke protocol
Acute dyspnea, orthopnea, or pulmonary edema — acute heart failure
records.western_context_zh: 西醫治療包含限制鈉鹽、規律運動，以及使用 ACEi/ARB、CCB、利尿劑等降壓藥物（高血壓/I10）；此處僅供學術對照，非治療指示。
records.western_context_en: Managed with dietary sodium restriction, exercise, and antihypertensives (ACEi/ARB, CCB, thiazides). Documentation context only.
